claims.disproof_condition: 條件：三星電機的 DART、財報或法說寫出與 NVIDIA 的 ABF 供貨協議縮減、終止，或世宗／釜山專用線延後；或 NVIDIA 一手不再把三星電機列為載板夥伴。核查頻率：每季（三星電機財報與 DART、NVIDIA 10-Q）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註或降 confidence，重讀 IC 載板層供給側。
claims.statement: Samsung Electro-Mechanics' own release: SEMCO and NVIDIA will jointly invest in dedicated ABF package-substrate lines at Sejong and Busan; supply covers substrates for NVIDIA compute chipsets and for high-speed networking switches, with deliveries from 2026 and volume growing at a double-digit annual rate over multiple years; by 2028 NVIDIA's allocation is projected to be a significant portion of SEMCO's total package-substrate capacity. NVIDIA's EVP of operations is quoted in the release ('broadens our network of substrate partners'). Supplier-issued, corroborated by NVIDIA's own release the same day (different origin_entity). No contract value; this is not the 2026-10-19 DART single supply contract (memory package substrates per SEMCO, unnamed 'global major' counterparty, calendar 2027).

source_doc.title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Press Release 2026-10-21：Samsung Electro-Mechanics and NVIDIA Announce Strategic Partnership to Supply ABF Substrates（世宗、釜山專用線共同投資；2026 年起交貨；運算晶片與高速網路交換器載板）

sources.quote: Samsung Electro-Mechanics and NVIDIA Announce Strategic Partnership to Supply ABF Substrates

Under the agreement, the two companies will jointly invest in expanding dedicated manufacturing facilities for ABF package substrates used in AI semiconductors. Leveraging the expanded production capacity, Samsung Electro-Mechanics plans to supply NVIDIA ABF package substrates beginning in 2026.

sources.locator: ■ Dedicated Production Facilities 段第 2 段
sources.quote: The supply agreement covers advanced package substrates for NVIDIA's compute chipsets, as well as substrates for high-speed networking switches that enable ultra-fast chip-to-chip connectivity within data centers. Deliveries will start in 2026.

sources.locator: ■ Dedicated Production Facilities 段第 3 段
sources.quote: Over a multi-year period, starting in 2026, the volume of package substrates supplied by Samsung Electro-Mechanics to NVIDIA is expected to increase at a double-digit annual rate. By 2028, production allocated to NVIDIA is projected to account for a significant portion of Samsung Electro-Mechanics' total annual package substrate production capacity.

sources.locator: NVIDIA 營運執行副總裁 Debora Shoquist 引述
sources.quote: Our work with Samsung Electro-Mechanics broadens our network of substrate partners and adds manufacturing capacity to help us scale production and deliver the accelerated computing platforms our customers need.
